goal: Add pure helpers to mute and unmute a chat thread's notifications, exported from the chat feature.

requirements.text: toggleMute(settings, chatId) SHALL return a new MuteSettings with chatId appended to mutedChatIds when chatId is not muted, and SHALL NOT mutate the input.

examples.then: result.mutedChatIds is ['a','b'] and settings.mutedChatIds is still ['a']

requirements.text: toggleMute(settings, chatId) SHALL remove chatId from mutedChatIds when chatId is muted, keeping the order of the other ids.
isMuted(settings, chatId) SHALL return true if and only if chatId is in settings.mutedChatIds.

tests: does not mutate the input settings
unmutes a muted chat and keeps the order of the others
